text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… Sigh.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (The breeze is so refreshing… And yet the heat inside me will not abate.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (It must be not fatigue… but exhilaration.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Tomorrow is finally the day…
Y-you're here!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh, Teio?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hey. I'll have you know I've been searching far and wide for you! At least carry your phone with you!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Geez… Here you go! It's pretty much room temperature now, though.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh… Honeyade?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Just a little treat for ya. Go ahead and take a breather!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Tomorrow's the Yasuda Kinen, right? You've gotta go at it on a full tank!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Teio… Hehe. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: …Oh yeah, Zephyr. While I'm here, there's something I should tell you.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Before the spring season's over, I'm gonna make a comeback! No matter what!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: With how my schedule's looking, it'll be… pretty tight, to be honest.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: But still, I'm gonna pull through. And when I do…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm entering the autumn Tenno Sho—and I'm gonna fulfill the promise we made!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Teio…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Sooo… don't you go losing either, Zephyr!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I won't be coming to watch you this time. I have my own battle to fight.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: But I'm gonna recover and make a comeback. You can count on that.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: And I'm going to win the Yasuda Kinen and the Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yep. And then, we'll settle things at the autumn Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: So… here's to giving it our all! Cheers!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Apologies. I already finished my drink.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Already?!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Well, it was very delicious. I couldn't help myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so it arrives—the day of the Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiichi Ruby and Daitaku Helios are competing today, but they're not the only runners to be reckoned with…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's also Ikuno Dictus, whose intense racing schedule has helped her slowly but surely gain strength.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …It's all right, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I am anxious, but I'm also fine.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I'll pull in everything around me, and use it to add greater force to my wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: That is what I must do!
